=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:299 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `FAILURE_REASON_DETAIL` is read with `sed -n '2p'`, so any multiline failure detail would be truncated to only the first line.
  WHY: Both reviewers identified the same potential loss of detail in the failure-summary readback path; one reviewer noted the sanitization may prevent it, but the finding was still reported on the same code path and severity is the highest reported.
- tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py:27 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test assertion was reported as potentially mismatching the workflow’s `\r` sanitization pattern.
  WHY: Both reviewers raised the same test-string concern on the same line, though both also noted it may be a false positive; severity is the highest reported.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:299 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `FAILURE_REASON_DETAIL` is read with `sed -n '2p'`, so any multiline failure detail would be truncated to only the first line.
  WHY: If `detail` contains newline characters or `\n` sequences not handled by sanitization, `printf` writes multiple lines and `sed -n '2p'` only captures the first line of detail.
- tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py:27 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The test checks for `$'\\r'` and was reported as potentially mismatching the actual workflow escape syntax.
  WHY: The reviewer believed the string pattern could be off, though they also noted the test passed and may not actually be a runtime issue.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:310 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The summary step redundantly checks `FAILURE_REASON_CODE` before reading the failure-reason file.
  WHY: The reviewer judged the fallback read path unnecessary because the `update` step already sets outputs before failing, so the extra file-read branch may never be needed.
- tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The assertion on `detail_sanitized` was flagged as potentially fragile due to backslash escaping in the Python string literal.
  WHY: The reviewer noted the test could fail if the literal pattern did not match the shell syntax exactly, though they also observed the current CI passed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yl | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The sanitization logic was reported as not replacing actual carriage-return and newline characters as intended.
  WHY: The reviewer argued that the parameter expansion using `$'\r'` and `$'\n'` would not sanitize real control characters, leaving raw newlines in the failure reason file.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:299 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `sed -n '2p'` only captures the first line of the failure-detail file.
  WHY: The reviewer said multiline details would be truncated if they reach the summary step, because only line 2 is read back.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
